months.note: First month of the Gaudiya year, beginning after Gaura-pūrṇimā.
Nṛsiṁha Caturdaśī falls in the śukla-pakṣa.
Ratha-yātrā and the start of Cāturmāsya — the heaviest observance month in the stream data (87 Cāturmāsya streams).
Jhūlana-yātrā is the only festival the Gīti-guccha groups explicitly (p.374).
Densest appearance-day month: Janmāṣṭamī and Rādhāṣṭamī two weeks apart.
Gopī-gīta is 10/10 October in the stream data; Rāsa 86% concentrated Sep–Nov.
The strongest seasonal signal in the whole dataset: Dāmodarāṣṭakam appears in 52 streams, 100% of them in Oct–Nov. The Gīti-guccha prints it (p.290) with no seasonal note at all.
Sparse month — mostly ācārya observance days, no dedicated festival songs in the corpus.
Nityānanda Trayodaśī and Advaita Saptamī both fall here.
Gaura-pūrṇimā closes the Gaudiya year; the next day begins Caitra.
Intercalary leap month, roughly every 2.7 years (last 2023, next 2026-05-16 → 2026-06-15). The @madhudas channel ran Śaraṇāgati songs through it (59 streams), which is what these uids reflect.
